children: Daedalus signed a non-binding Letter of Intent to combine with HubX so HubX can become a Nasdaq-listed public company.
Signed non-binding LOI with HubX for a proposed business combination to list HubX on Nasdaq.
HubX is a Turkiye-based consumer AI company with apps downloaded over 600M times and ~100M monthly users.
HubX received an investment of up to $75m in connection with the proposed transaction.
Transaction subject to definitive agreements, due diligence, shareholder and regulatory approvals, and listing standards.
